name: CHAMP
description: A challenging dataset of high school math competition problems annotated with concepts and hints to enable fine-grained analysis of LLMs' mathematical reasoning capabilities and their use of side information.
reputation: A recent math competition benchmark that is gaining attention for analyzing reasoning with hints and concepts, but is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Includes annotations of concepts, hints, and model-generated solution correctness; best model scores 58.1% in standard settings.
